To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

NAPA-73 binds to NF in neurons and to vimentin in mesenchymal cells, that it co-precipitates with NF and vimentin in embryonic chick brain homogenates, that it binds to NF in vitro, that it has an isoelectric point of 5.0, and that it is an acidic protein with an apparent molecular weight of 73,000.
we have isolated and partially characterized a novel intermediate filament-associated neuronal protein that binds to vimentin in 4-day-old embryos and to NFs in 20-day-old embryos.

we have identified and characterized a novel intermediate filament-associated 73 kDa protein, NAPA, which binds to vimentin filaments in embryonic chick fibroblasts and to neurofilaments in mature neurons.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the characterization of an intermediate filament-associated 73,000-d polypeptide, NAPA- 73, that binds different intermediate filament types during development.
the identification of proteins that are associated with intermediate filaments.
the identification of proteins that are associated with the neurofilaments in neurons.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
NAPA-73 is an avian-specific, intermediate filament-associated protein which binds to vimentin filaments in early embryogenesis and to neurofilaments in mature neurons.

the E/C 8-antibodies recognize an intermediate filament-associated 73,000-d protein that is developmentally regulated and that binds to different intermediate filament types at different developmental stages.
the NAPA-73 protein is an intermediate filament protein that is expressed in a variety of embryonic cell types.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have identified a new intermediate filament-associated protein and have demonstrated that it is expressed in different filament types at various stages of embryonic development.

we have discovered a novel, avian-specific protein, NAPA73, which is associated with intermediate filaments in embryonic cells, binds to different filament systems in different cell types, and is expressed in various cell types in the nervous system.
the E/C 8-monoclon al antibody binds to a novel intermediate filament-associated 73,000D protein that is expressed in neurons at early stages of development.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the monoclonal E/C8- antibody recognizes a 73, 000-D protein, NAPA 73, that associates with NFs in mature neurons, but with vimen- tin in immature cells.
NAPA-73 is a novel intermediate filament-associated neuronal protein.
NAPA-73 binds to different intermediate filaments in different cell types during embryonic development.
